name: concourse
exits: shore, rotunda, plaza, cabin, hall, lawn, refectory, thicket
exits: orchard, den, overlook, gallery, glade, grotto, spring, atrium
exits: lodge, stall, parlour, mirror_hall, oak, rampart, copse

A long curved corridor with a door to everywhere, each one labelled in a
small neat hand. It is not a room anybody stays in. It is the room you pass
through on the way to the one you meant.
